description:
The terms "entitlement" (LPBS download gating for paid users) and "approval" (deployment-manager release gating for platform quality) are used in overlapping contexts, creating confusion about which system controls what. Add a terminology section to the desktop release system contract and update inline code comments in `download_hosting.go` (entitlement) and `approvals_handler.go` (approval) to cross-reference the distinction.

Source: research/desktop-release-control-plane-audit conclusion — Finding 9 gap #5.
name: desktop-entitlement-vs-approval-docs
title: Clarify entitlement vs approval terminology in desktop release documentation
